name: DESCHUTES TITLE
address: 397 SW UPPER TERRACE DR, BEND, OR 97702

fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers visible from the street at the driveway entrance.
• Mark the rear access point with a reflective sign or marker so responders can locate it quickly at night or in low visibility.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles on both sides and overhead.
• Keep the rear access route clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and stored materials at all times.
• Post the address visibly on the detached structure if it has a separate entrance accessible from the access drive.
• Cut back dense vegetation that reduces visibility of the main residence and detached structure from the street.
• Keep all access points unlocked or fitted with a lock type compatible with local fire department access tools.
• Clear a staging area near the main residence large enough for responders to work without repositioning equipment.
• Mark or identify which access point leads to the rear of the property to reduce navigation time for arriving responders.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches and shrubs that are directly touching or overhanging the structure.
• Thin trees within the cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Keep low branches on scattered trees trimmed up to reduce pathways from ground-level vegetation to the tree canopy.
• Maintain the open green space between vegetation and the structure by keeping it mowed and free of dead plant material.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along their full length.
